title: Protective Helmets for Two Wheeler Riders - Specification
scope_text: This standard specifies requirements for design, construction, workmanship, finish, and performance test methods for protective helmets intended for riders of two-wheeled motor vehicles. It prescribes critical criteria for shock absorption, penetration resistance, dynamic retention under load, and peripheral vision clearance. Compliance ensures adequate head cranial protection during vehicular impact.

title: Specification for Industrial Safety Helmets
scope_text: Specifies physical, structural, and performance requirements for helmets worn by personnel in industrial, mining, civil construction, and tunnel engineering sites. Covers shell materials, harness suspension systems, shock absorption, flammability, and electrical insulation against accidental high-voltage contact.

title: Visors for Protective Helmets for Two Wheeler Riders - Specification

title: Specification for Non-metallic Helmets for Industrial Workers
scope_text: Historic standard covering molded thermosetting and thermoplastic helmets for manufacturing operations. Laid down basic shock absorption and water absorption parameters before consolidation under modern industrial helmet specifications.

title: Tactical and Riot Control Helmets for Police and Paramilitary Forces
scope_text: Specifies rigorous structural and ballistic-fragmentation performance criteria for tactical helmets used in riot dispersion and civil security operations. Prescribes reinforced composite shells, face shields resistant to chemical and blunt impact, and neck protection shrouds.

title: Sports Helmets - Helmets for Pedal Cyclists and Users of Skateboards and Roller Skates

title: Specification for Wooden Headforms for Testing of Helmets
scope_text: Specifies anthropometric dimensions, hardwood material properties, and profile contours of wooden headforms utilized across Indian standards for testing impact attenuation, penetration resistance, and chinstrap retention of protective headgear.

title: Guide for Selection of Industrial Safety Equipment for Head Protection
scope_text: Provides technical guidelines for safety engineers and procurement officers regarding selection, fitting, maintenance, and replacement cycles for industrial helmets based on hazard severity such as falling debris, lateral crush, and molten metal splash.

title: Guide for Selection of Industrial Safety Equipment for Eye, Face and Ear Protection
scope_text: Comprehensive recommendation guide for integrating eye visors, face shields, and ear defenders with standard industrial and construction safety helmets to maintain balanced ergonomic protection without compromising cranial shell integrity.

title: Specification for Equipment for Eye and Face Protection during Welding
scope_text: Covers helmets, hand shields, and goggles engineered to shield operators from harmful optical radiation (ultraviolet and infrared), sparks, and spatter during gas and electric arc welding operations.

certification.scheme_reference: Personal Protective Equipment Quality Control Order / BIS Scheme-I

title: Industrial Safety Belts and Harnesses - Specification
scope_text: Prescribes requirements for personal fall-arrest harnesses, lanyards, and anchorage fittings commonly coupled with industrial safety helmets during scaffolding, high-elevation construction, and tower transmission maintenance.

certification.scheme_reference: Industrial Safety Equipment QCO / BIS Scheme-I

title: Specification for Performance Requirements for Fire Helmets
scope_text: Outlines advanced thermo-mechanical shock resistance, water immersion stability, and flame retardance requirements for structural fire helmets utilized by municipal and aviation rescue fire services.

certification.scheme_reference: Firefighting Equipment Certification Order / BIS Scheme-I

title: Safety of Toys - Part 1: Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties
scope_text: Covers mechanical safety parameters including prohibitions against rigid protrusions, choking hazards, and simulated imitation helmets sold as toys that do not offer cranial impact protection.

certification.scheme_reference: Toys (Quality Control) Order, 2020 / BIS Scheme-I

title: High Visibility Warning Clothing for Professional Use - Test Methods and Requirements
scope_text: Specifies photometric performance of retroreflective tapes and fluorescent background fabrics applied to industrial workwear and helmet shells to maximize worker conspicuity under low-light hazardous highway conditions.

title: Basic Environmental Testing Procedures for Electronic and Electrical Items: Part 1 General

scope_text: Prescribes requirements for design, materials, construction, welding procedures, heat treatment, and pressure testing of refillable welded low carbon steel gas cylinders exceeding 5-litre water capacity intended for domestic and commercial LPG storage. Covers standard 14.2 kg domestic and 19 kg commercial cylinders.

title: Valve Fittings for Use with Domestic LPG Cylinders (Exceeding 5-Litre Water Capacity) - Specification

title: Rubber Hoses for Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) - Specification
scope_text: Specifies requirements for wire-braided and fabric-reinforced flexible rubber hoses (Suraksha hoses) used for linking domestic and commercial LPG regulators to gas stoves. Covers burst pressure resistance, ozone degradation resistance, and flame propagation resistance.

scope_text: Covers lightweight corrosion-resistant welded aluminium alloy cylinders for low pressure liquefiable hydrocarbons used in marine craft and aeronautical life-support applications.

title: Hydrostatic Stretch Test Method for Gas Cylinders

title: Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification (Unifying 33, 43, and 53 Grades)
scope_text: Covers chemical and physical requirements for Ordinary Portland Cement across grades 33, 43, and 53 consolidated under a unified specification. Prescribes limits on insoluble residue, magnesia, loss on ignition, fineness by Blaine air permeability method, setting times, soundess by Le-Chatelier and autoclave, and compressive strengths at 3, 7, and 28 days. This is the foundational standard for concrete infrastructure in India.

title: 43 Grade Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification

title: 53 Grade Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification
scope_text: Former standalone standard for high-strength 53 Grade Ordinary Portland Cement used in high-rise towers, prestressed girders, and precast concrete components. Subsumed under consolidated IS 269:2015.

title: Portland Pozzolana Cement - Specification: Part 1 Fly Ash Based
scope_text: Specifies manufacturing requirements, pozzolanic activity ratios, and performance criteria for Portland Pozzolana Cement utilizing 15% to 35% pulverized fuel ash (fly ash). Widely used in hydraulic structures, marine construction, and mass concrete placements due to reduced heat of hydration and sulphate resistance.

certification.scheme_reference: Cement (Quality Control) Order, 2020 / BIS Scheme-I (Mandatory ISI Mark)

title: Portland Pozzolana Cement - Specification: Part 2 Calcined Clay Based

certification.scheme_reference: Cement (Quality Control) Order, 2020 / BIS Scheme-I

title: Portland Slag Cement (PSC) - Specification
scope_text: Specifies composition, physical fineness, and chemical parameters of Portland Slag Cement manufactured by intimately grinding Portland cement clinker, gypsum, and granulated blast furnace slag (25% to 70%). Highly recommended for sewage treatment plants, coastal jetties, and marine piling.

certification.scheme_reference: Cement (Quality Control) Order, 2020 / BIS Scheme-I

title: Rapid Hardening Portland Cement - Specification
scope_text: Prescribes high tricalcium silicate (C3S) content and extra-fine grinding criteria for rapid hardening Portland cement developed for fast formwork stripping, precast concrete factories, and emergency cold-weather road repairs.

certification.scheme_reference: Cement (Quality Control) Order, 2020 / BIS Scheme-I

title: White Portland Cement - Specification
scope_text: Specifies manufacturing parameters and iron oxide limit (< 0.4%) for white Portland cement intended for architectural facades, terrazzo tile flooring, decorative grouting, and ornamental casting. Includes minimum 70% Hunter L-scale whiteness index test.

certification.scheme_reference: Cement (Quality Control) Order, 2020 / BIS Scheme-I

title: Hydrophobic Portland Cement - Specification
scope_text: Covers Portland cement interground with oleic or stearic acid film-forming agents that form a water-repellent protective layer around cement grains, preventing premature hydration during long maritime transport and monsoon warehouse storage.

certification.scheme_reference: Cement (Quality Control) Order, 2020 / BIS Scheme-I

title: Sulphate Resisting Portland Cement - Specification
scope_text: Specifies chemical composition limiting tricalcium aluminate (C3A) to less than 5.0% to prevent expansive ettringite formation in soils and groundwater with severe sulphate salt concentrations.

certification.scheme_reference: Cement (Quality Control) Order, 2020 / BIS Scheme-I

title: Low Heat Portland Cement - Specification
scope_text: Specifies cement with reduced heat of hydration (< 65 cal/g at 7 days) formulated for massive dam concrete, gravity spillways, and heavy foundation rafts to avoid thermal contraction cracking.

certification.scheme_reference: Cement (Quality Control) Order, 2020 / BIS Scheme-I

title: Composite Cement - Specification
scope_text: Specifies ternary blended cement engineered by combining Portland clinker with both granulated blast furnace slag (20-50%) and fly ash (15-35%). Maximizes carbon offset while ensuring enhanced durability in aggressive chemical environments.

certification.scheme_reference: Cement (Quality Control) Order, 2020 / BIS Scheme-I

title: Specification for Standard Sand for Testing of Cement
scope_text: Specifies physical grading, silica purity (> 98%), and grain shape of Indian standard sand obtained from Ennore (Tamil Nadu) used across all Indian laboratories for mortar cube compressive strength determination.

certification.scheme_reference: Standard Sand Certification Scheme / BIS Scheme-I

title: Methods of Physical Tests for Hydraulic Cement: Part 1 Determination of Fineness by Dry Sieving
scope_text: Prescribes apparatus and procedure for determining residue on 90-micron IS sieve for monitoring coarse fraction in milled hydraulic cements.

title: Methods of Physical Tests for Hydraulic Cement: Part 4 Determination of Consistency of Standard Cement Paste
scope_text: Prescribes Vicat apparatus plunging needle methodology for calculating standard normal consistency water percentage (P) necessary for subsequent setting time and soundness evaluations.

title: Methods of Physical Tests for Hydraulic Cement: Part 5 Determination of Initial and Final Setting Times
scope_text: Specifies Vicat needle penetration timings for establishing initial setting time (minimum 30 minutes) and final setting time (maximum 600 minutes) of hydraulic cement pastes.

title: Methods of Physical Tests for Hydraulic Cement: Part 6 Determination of Compressive Strength of Hydraulic Cement (Other than Masonry Cement)
scope_text: Details the standard test procedure for casting, water curing at 27±2°C, and crushing 70.6 mm mortar cubes prepared with standard Ennore sand to verify 3-day, 7-day, and 28-day compliance.

title: Method of Chemical Analysis of Hydraulic Cement
scope_text: Details referee chemical gravimetric and titrimetric methods for quantifying silica, alumina, ferric oxide, lime, magnesia, sulfuric anhydride, insoluble residue, and loss on ignition.

title: Pulverized Fuel Ash: Part 1 For Use as Pozzolana in Cement, Cement Mortar and Concrete
scope_text: Specifies chemical and physical requirements for coal thermal power plant fly ash (reactive silica, carbon content, fineness) utilized in blending Portland Pozzolana Cement under IS 1489.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) - Specification
scope_text: Prescribes stringent physical, organoleptic, chemical, heavy metal, radiological, and microbiological standards for water derived from any potable source subjected to treatment (e.g. reverse osmosis, demineralization, ozonation, filtration) and sealed in food-grade plastic or glass containers for direct human consumption. Sets zero-tolerance limits for E. coli, coliforms, faecal streptococci, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa, as well as strict thresholds for total dissolved solids (TDS), pesticide residues, bromates, and microplastics.

title: Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) and Its Copolymers for Safe Contact with Drinking Water

title: Polyalkylene Terephthalates (PET/PBT) for Safe Contact with Foodstuffs and Drinking Water
scope_text: Defines virgin polymer specifications and catalyst thresholds for safe manufacture of PET containers holding water and edible beverages.

title: Methods of Sampling and Test for Water: Part 11 Determination of pH

title: Methods of Sampling and Test for Water: Part 16 Determination of Filterable Residue (Total Dissolved Solids - TDS)
scope_text: Prescribes gravimetric drying protocol at 180°C for measuring total dissolved solids (TDS) in raw and processed water.

title: Methods of Sampling and Test for Water: Part 47 Determination of Lead in Water
scope_text: Specifies atomic absorption spectrophotometric (AAS) and inductively coupled plasma (ICP) testing protocols for detecting sub-microgram lead contamination.

title: Methods of Sampling and Microbiological Examination of Water
scope_text: Prescribes aseptic sample collection, membrane filtration, and incubation protocols for detecting total viable colony counts, coliform bacteria, and faecal streptococci.

title: Ultraviolet (UV) Water Disinfection Systems - Specification
scope_text: Specifies minimum germicidal UV dose (40 mJ/cm2), lamp intensity sensors, and fail-safe automated solenoid shutoffs for continuous microbiological inactivation in bottling plants.

title: Reverse Osmosis (RO) Based Point of Use Water Treatment Systems - Specification
scope_text: Prescribes membrane salt rejection efficiency (> 90%), recovery ratio, recovery of essential minerals, and microbiological reduction factors for domestic and commercial RO units.

title: Guidelines for Recycling of Plastics Packaging Used in Bottled Water
scope_text: Prescribes resin identification codes, mechanical sorting protocols, and post-consumer decontamination standards for closed-loop recycling of plastic water containers.
